CHAPTER.VERS: How hast thou helped without power? savest thou the arm no strength?
How hast thou counselled no wisdom? and hast thou abundantly declared the thing as it is?
To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

Dead are formed from under the waters, and its inhabitants.
and the…: or, with the inhabitants
Hell naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, hangeth the earth upon nothing.
He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not torn under them.
He holdeth back the face of his throne, spreadeth his cloud upon it.

He hath surrounded the waters with a border, until the day and night come to an end.
until…: Heb. until the end of light with darkness
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

He divideth the sea by his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
the proud: Heb. pride
By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
Lo, these parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
